title: 第153章 开启玩家主线任务：生存
slug: 求生游戏请叫我诚信商人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

李知在这极限的三秒隐身时间里，将速度和耳力发挥到了极致。

向前狂奔的同时，也把沉的话听得清清楚楚。

她一边思考沉怎么突然来找她，一边掏出最后一张隐身一次性天赋卡，再次复制了一张之后，就马上使用了。

在靴子的3秒隐身效果结束后之后，立即衔接上了。

沉却像是若有所感般，回头看向李知离开的方向。

“刚才那边有动静。”

护卫们上前查看，什么也没有发现。

沉思索片刻：“走，再回去看看。”

她转身就往李知的方向折返。

李知此刻已经跑出2公里外，并不知道沉突然改变主意。

她回到希维尔的小屋，马上就找到了吴垠。

“今天是不是有个鳞族来找我。”

吴垠放下手里的机械：“一个鳞族商人。”

李知脸色一下子又青又黑。

罗红也就算了，沉干什么也来找她？

总不至于是前两天没抓到她，看到她领悟了强者之心，也想要分一块肉吧？

吴垠看着她脸色变幻，嗤笑一声：“你在外面到底得罪了多少人？不是以和为贵吗？”

李知被她揶揄，在零件堆里找了个空隙，一屁股坐下了，很是烦躁道：“我怎么知道？你看我这样子像是故意得罪人的吗？我就差把‘把我当个屁放了’写在脸上了，有些人就是心眼子比针尖还小。”

“还是天启大陆的人有智慧，没被你的花言巧语骗过去。”

李知：“巧了，追杀我的那个就是最莽的那个，她压根不听我说话，拿把刀就上来了，我除了跑还能怎么办？”

吴垠：“这叫透过现象看本质，你说人家莽，我看人家是大智若愚，而且……”

她拨动齿轮的手突然一顿，眼前出现一块虚拟屏幕，语气微变：“那个商人带着她的护卫又折返回来了。”

李知立即站了起来：“到哪了？”

吴垠：“刚进入修理区的院子，现在正在到处查看。”

林中小屋和修理区还间隔了一小片森林。

李知要在飞舟两百米范围内才能传送到其他地方。

而且沉不知道是狗鼻子还是狗耳朵，格外灵敏，这时候就算是隐身过去也容易被她抓住。

李知干脆掏出之前给章柏雕刻时，备用的传送魔法石：“我上楼传送，沉为难你，你就去找你老师给你撑腰啊。”

吴垠见她有办法，紧绷着的身体才逐渐放松，她淡淡道：“放心，在哪个世界，正常人都不会为难一个和她没有利益关系的瘸子，一个瘸子也没办法帮你一个正常人逃跑或者做什么。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Li Zhi used his speed and ear power to the extreme during his three-second limit of invisibility.

While running forward, he also heard Shen's words clearly.

While she was thinking about why Shen suddenly came to her, she took out the last invisible one-time talent card, copied it again, and used it immediately.

After the 3-second invisibility effect of the boots ends, it connects immediately.

As if feeling something, Shen turned back and looked in the direction Li Zhi left.

"There was movement over there just now."

The guards came forward to check and found nothing.

He pondered for a moment and said, "Let's go back and have a look."

She turned around and headed back in the direction of Li Zhi.

Li Zhi had already run 2 kilometers away and did not know that Shen suddenly changed his mind.

She returned to Sivir's hut and found Wu Yin immediately.

"Did someone from the Scale Clan come to see me today?"

Wu Yin put down the machine in his hand: "A scale businessman."

Li Zhi's face turned green and black all of a sudden.

Luo Hong didn't care, why did Shen Gan come to her?

It’s not like we didn’t catch her two days ago. Seeing that she has understood the heart of a strong person, you also want a piece of meat, right?

Wu Yin watched her expression change and sneered: "How many people have you offended outside? Don't you think peace is the most important thing?"

Li Zhi was teased by her, found a gap in the pile of parts, sat down, and said irritably: "How do I know? Do you think I am deliberately offending others? I almost wrote 'I'm a piece of shit' written on my face. Some people are just as narrow-minded as the tip of a needle."

"The people of Apocalypse Continent are still smart and have not been deceived by your sweet words."

Li Zhi: "What a coincidence, the one who chased me was the most reckless one. She didn't listen to me at all and just came up with a knife. What else could I do except run away?"

Wu Yin: "This is called looking at the essence through phenomena. You say someone is reckless, but I think they are wise and foolish, and..."

Her hand turning the gear suddenly paused, and a virtual screen appeared in front of her eyes. Her tone changed slightly: "The businessman returned with her guards."

Li Zhi immediately stood up: "Where are you?"

Wu Yin: "I just entered the yard of the repair area and am now checking everywhere."

There is also a small forest between the forest hut and the repair area.

Li Zhi can only teleport to other places if he is within two hundred meters of the flying boat.

Moreover, Shen didn't know if it was a dog's nose or ears, but they were extremely sensitive. Even if he was invisible, he would be easily caught by her at this time.

Li Zhi simply took out the spare teleportation magic stone that he had used when carving for Zhang Bai: "I'll teleport upstairs. If Shen makes things difficult for you, go find your teacher to support you."

Wu Yin saw that she had a solution, and her tense body gradually relaxed. She said calmly: "Don't worry, in any world, normal people will not embarrass a cripple who has no interest in her, and a cripple cannot help you, a normal person, escape or do anything."
